run_single_point_orca: run a single-point energy and gradient calculation for a molecule using ORCA
run_geometry_optimization_orca: run a geometry optimization for a molecule using ORCA with ASE relaxation
run_orca_with_nbo: run an ORCA single-point calculation with Natural Bond Orbital analysis enabled
run_orca_metal_organics: run an ORCA calculation with symmetry breaking for metal-organic systems
run_orca_parallel: run an ORCA calculation parallelized across multiple CPU cores
